input.title: [iOS] Incorrect button name: Unmark as done button on iOS app
input.body: ## Step to reproduce 1. Open the app on iOS capacitor app 2. Scroll up to open Setting 3. Tap Setting 4. Tap Customized Toolbar 5. Tap Checkmark button ## Current behavior Button name: Unmark as Done Copy: Unmark a thought as done ## Expected behavior Name and copy should match with Mobile Safari, Android, and Chrome version Button name: Mark as Done Copy: Crossed a thought to mark it as completed
